evidence: Source-inspected workspace docs/ITEM_IDS.md (user-supplied 2026-11-13 import and pending IDs) and hunt_panel.lua. Item mappings, prices and buyers are not client-verified.

fieldNotes.price: NPC sell price in gold for sellTo where known; 0 means unknown or unset, not a confirmed zero value.
fieldNotes.sellTo: Chosen NPC name or buyer group for this item's price; empty string means unknown or unset. Djinn groups do not identify the individual NPC.
fieldNotes.name: Empty string means the item name has not been supplied.
fieldNotes.aliases: Other supplied names for this ID; may be aliases or unresolved conflicting mappings.
fieldNotes.pendingOffers: Name-based offers without a confirmed unique item ID; never use candidateIds as verified mappings.
fieldNotes.buyerSelection: One price and one buyer per item. Imported buyer selected from the highest listed offer matching the retained price; existing explicit sellTo choices preserved. Alternative offers omitted.

offerSource.mappingCaution: Source warns some hardcoded TibiaWiki IDs, especially wands/rods, differ on this server. Matches use registry names/aliases, not client evidence.
